platform.name: Volvo V70 (2008, P3)
platform.cars: Volvo V70 2008 diesel (tested), an example of a car that is not electric. The engine control module (Bosch EDC16) on the standard OBD address 0x7E0 with its fault codes, identification and the SAE J1979 values it answers as 0xF4xx; the central electronic module 0x726, ABS 0x760 and electric parking brake 0x756 with values named after OBDb's V60, XC60 and S80 sets. Engine speed, speed, coolant, outside temperature, voltage and odometer on the dashboard. Volvo ECUs on 29-bit addresses are not read.

ecus.notes: Answered the ECU search of 0x7E0-0x7E7 on 2026-10-20 (the only one) and UDS fault code reads (19 02): the program and the command line read the same four failing codes. Software identification names a Bosch EDC16 (0xF180). Answers the SAE J1979 PIDs as identifiers 0xF4xx.

confidence_levels.confirmed: Checked against the dashboard or another known value on a real car: the car this file was tested on, or recordings of real cars published by others
confidence_levels.reported: Name or formula from one source (a publication or a single own observation), not checked against a known value
confidence_levels.unverified: Identifier responds; the formula is an educated guess
confidence_levels.unknown: Identifier responds; the meaning of the bytes is not worked out

blocks.why: Run these first: readable software and hardware numbers mean the link to the engine control module works.
The SAE J1979 PIDs read with service 0x22 as identifiers 0xF4xx (ISO 27145 mapping); this engine control module answers them.
Standardised by ISO 14229: part numbers and software versions, mostly ASCII.

sources.notes: ISO 14229 (UDS), the diagnostic standard; defines the F1xx identification identifiers.
A scan of an identifier range by this program on the tested 2008 Volvo V70; the notes give the dates. Times are Finnish local time.
SAE J1979 (OBD-II PIDs); ISO 27145 maps PID xx to identifier 0xF4xx, which this engine control module answers with service 0x22.
OBDb signal sets for the Volvo S80, V60 and XC60 (the same P3 generation): ECU addresses, identifiers, names and scales. Only the identifiers that answered on the tested V70 are used.
